query:
SELECT tg.id AS "id!"
        FROM tournament_groups tg
        WHERE tg.state = 'open'
          AND NOT EXISTS (
              SELECT 1 FROM matches m
              WHERE m.tournament_group_id = tg.id
                AND m.status <> 'finished'
          )
          AND EXISTS (
              SELECT 1 FROM matches m
              WHERE m.tournament_group_id = tg.id
          )
